name: streamContent
description: Play a movie or TV show. Use for 'put on X', 'play X on Netflix', 'watch X'. For specific episodes, use episode_query with keywords like 'the one about pirates' or 'the camping episode'. For random episodes, set random_episode=true.

title.description: Name of the movie or TV show

random_episode.description: If true, play a random episode (for TV shows)

episode_query.description: Keywords to find a specific episode by topic. Examples: 'pirates', 'camping', 'birthday party', 'the one where they go to the beach'
